cite.chooseSource: Please choose a source or create a new one.

linkFacts.title: Link facts
linkFacts.intro: Choose a person of the open family tree and tick the facts the citation supports – one person after the other, e.g. groom, bride, parents and witnesses of a marriage entry.

person.title: Sources
person.intro: Citations of the person, of their life events and of their relations. The book next to a fact shows how many citations it has.
person.empty: No citations yet. “Cite source” links a source with a fact of the person.
person.unlinkConfirm: Remove the citation of “{{source}}” from {{fact}}? The citation stays in the source.

repositories.empty: No archives yet. An archive (registry office, church records office, library, website) keeps sources; it is entered once and chosen for every source.
repositories.deleteConfirm: Move the archive “{{name}}” to the recycle bin? Its sources stay (sources: {{count}}) and show no archive until it is restored.

scans.title: Scans
scans.removeConfirm: Remove “{{name}}” here? The file is deleted once nothing else uses it.

reports.title: Reports
reports.intro: Print the data of the family tree or save it as a PDF – a sheet per person or family, ancestor and descendant lists.
reports.choosePersonHint: Choose a starting person for the report.

options.hideLiving: Living persons only with name and year of birth

reports.pdfHint: In the print dialog choose “Save as PDF” as the printer.
reports.printFailed: The report could not be printed.
reports.empty: The family tree has no persons yet.
reports.livingHidden: Details of living persons are not shown.
reports.nameAndPerson: Sources on the name and the person
reports.name: Name
